# Pretraining and the Lasso

This package fits pretrained generalized linear models for: (1) data
with grouped observations, (2) data without grouped observations, but
with multinomial responses, (3) data with multiple Gaussian responses
and (4) time series data (data with repeated measurements over time).

Documentation and examples are available as vignettes within this
package, and can be accessed through the “Articles” tab on this page.
The vignettes also include examples of pretraining for settings not yet
supported by this package, including conditional average treatment
effect estimation and unsupervised pretraining.

Details of pretraining may be found in Craig et
al. ([2026](#ref-ptlasso)).

All model fitting in this package is done with `cv.glmnet`, and our
syntax closely follows that of the `glmnet` package
([2010](#ref-glmnet)).

# Installation

To install this package, we recommend following [these
instructions](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/githubinstall/vignettes/githubinstall.html).

# Having trouble?

If you find a bug or have a feature request, please open a new issue.

# References

Craig et al. “Pretraining and the lasso.” *Journal of the Royal
Statistical Society Series B: Statistical Methodology* 88.1 (2026):
261-281.

Friedman, Hastie, and Tibshirani. 2010. “Regularization Paths for
Generalized Linear Models via Coordinate Descent.” *Journal of
Statistical Software, Articles* 33 (1): 1–22.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`binomial.example.data()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/binomial.example.data.md)
  : Simulate input grouped data (binomial outcome) for testing with
  ptLasso.

- [`coef(`*`<cv.ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/coef.cv.ptLasso.md)
  : Get the coefficients from a fitted cv.ptLasso model.

- [`coef(`*`<ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/coef.ptLasso.md)
  : Get the coefficients from a fitted ptLasso model.

- [`cv.ptLasso()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/cv.ptLasso.md)
  : Cross-validation for ptLasso

- [`gaussian.example.data()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/gaussian.example.data.md)
  : Simulate input grouped data (gaussian outcome) for testing with
  ptLasso.

- [`get.individual.support()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/get.individual.support.md)
  : Get the support for individual models

- [`get.overall.support()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/get.overall.support.md)
  : Get the support for the overall model

- [`get.pretrain.support()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/get.pretrain.support.md)
  : Get the support for pretrained models

- [`makedata()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/makedata.md)
  : Simulate input grouped data for testing with ptLasso.

- [`makedata.targetgroups()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/makedata.targetgroups.md)
  : Simulate target grouped data for testing with ptLasso.

- [`plot(`*`<cv.ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/plot.cv.ptLasso.md)
  :

  Plot the cross-validation curve produced by cv.ptLasso, as a function
  of the `alpha` values used.

- [`plot(`*`<ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/plot.ptLasso.md)
  : Plot the models trained by a ptLasso object

- [`predict(`*`<cv.ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/predict.cv.ptLasso.md)
  : Predict using a cv.ptLasso object.

- [`predict(`*`<ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/predict.ptLasso.md)
  : Predict using a ptLasso object.

- [`print(`*`<cv.ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/print.cv.ptLasso.md)
  : Print the cv.ptLasso object.

- [`print(`*`<predict.cv.ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/print.predict.cv.ptLasso.md)
  : Print the predict.cv.ptLasso object.

- [`print(`*`<predict.ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/print.predict.ptLasso.md)
  : Print the predict.ptLasso object.

- [`print(`*`<ptLasso>`*`)`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/print.ptLasso.md)
  : Print the ptLasso object.

- [`ptLasso()`](https://erincr.github.io/ptLasso/reference/ptLasso.md) :
  Fit a pretrained lasso model using glmnet.
